grammar.pattern: 常 / 常常 + action · 先…再…
grammar.purpose: Describe habits and order later actions
grammar.explanation: 常 and 常常 say that an action happens often. They go before the verb, after a stated subject: 我常在家学习. They are not exact frequency percentages. 再 marks a further or later action, often in 先…再…. Here 再 looks forward; 昨天又读了一遍 uses 又 for an already repeated action, not yesterday’s 再.

examples.zh: 我常在家读书，她常常上午学习。
examples.py: wǒ cháng zài jiā dú shū , tā cháng cháng shàng wǔ xué xí .
examples.en: I often read at home; she often studies in the morning.

examples.py: xiān chī wǎn fàn , zài qù shàng kè .
examples.en: Eat dinner first, then go to class.

commonMistakes.why: 常 is placed before the verb phrase, not between verb and object.

grammar.purpose: Place the circumstances before the action
grammar.explanation: Time expressions can precede the subject or follow it: 晚上我学习 / 我晚上学习. Place phrases such as 在家 normally precede the action. Adverbs such as 常常 and manner descriptions such as 认真地 also precede the action. A simple adjective can modify an action without 地: 慢一点读. Do not move an ordinary object into the place of a time phrase.

examples.zh: 我上午在家认真地读课文。
examples.py: wǒ shàng wǔ zài jiā rèn zhēn de dú kè wén .
examples.en: I read the lesson text carefully at home in the morning.

examples.py: xià kè hòu , wǒ men màn yī diǎn dú .
examples.en: After class, we read a little more slowly.

examples.py: wǎn shang wǒ zài zuò tīng xiě .
examples.en: I will do dictation again in the evening.

commonMistakes.why: Put the location before the action 学习.

dialogue.title: Finding fifteen minutes
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find when the friends can study together.

lines.zh: 你白天有时间学习吗？
lines.py: nǐ bái tiān yǒu shí jiān xué xí ma ?
lines.en: Do you have time to study during the day?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没有，我白天上班，六点下班。
lines.py: méi yǒu , wǒ bái tiān shàng bān , liù diǎn xià bān .
lines.en: No, I work in the daytime and finish at six.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 上午也不在家吗？
lines.py: shàng wǔ yě bù zài jiā ma ?
lines.en: Are you also away from home in the morning?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。我常常七点起，弟弟也起来了，他要上学。
lines.py: duì . wǒ cháng cháng qī diǎn qǐ , dì di yě qǐ lái le , tā yào shàng xué .
lines.en: Right. I often get up at seven. My younger brother gets up too; he needs to go to school.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 他什么时候放学？
lines.py: tā shén me shí hou fàng xué ?
lines.en: When does he finish school?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 下午四点。下班的时候，我常常很累。
lines.py: xià wǔ sì diǎn . xià bān de shí hou , wǒ cháng cháng hěn lèi .
lines.en: At four in the afternoon. I am often tired when I finish work.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 先吃饭，再学习十五分钟，行吗？
lines.py: xiān chī fàn , zài xué xí shí wǔ fēn zhōng , xíng ma ?
lines.en: Eat first, then study for fifteen minutes. Would that work?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行。我常在家读书，晚上也有汉语课。
lines.py: xíng . wǒ cháng zài jiā dú shū , wǎn shang yě yǒu hàn yǔ kè .
lines.en: Yes. I often read at home, and I also have a Chinese class in the evening.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 几点下课？下课前做听写吗？
lines.py: jǐ diǎn xià kè ? xià kè qián zuò tīng xiě ma ?
lines.en: When does class finish? Do you do dictation before it finishes?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 九点下课。对，老师读，我们写。
lines.py: jiǔ diǎn xià kè . duì , lǎo shī dú , wǒ men xiě .
lines.en: It finishes at nine. Yes, the teacher reads and we write.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 下课后再说五分钟汉语吧。
lines.py: xià kè hòu zài shuō wǔ fēn zhōng hàn yǔ ba .
lines.en: Let us speak Chinese for another five minutes after class.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，别太晚。我十一点睡。
lines.py: hǎo , bié tài wǎn . wǒ shí yī diǎn shuì .
lines.en: Okay, but not too late. I go to sleep at eleven.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A weekday note
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Find three parts of the routine and the small practice slot.

lines.zh: 我白天上班，弟弟白天上学。
lines.py: wǒ bái tiān shàng bān , dì di bái tiān shàng xué .
lines.en: I work during the day; my younger brother goes to school.

lines.zh: 上午七点我起来，先吃早饭，再出去。
lines.py: shàng wǔ qī diǎn wǒ qǐ lái , xiān chī zǎo fàn , zài chū qù .
lines.en: I get up at seven in the morning, eat breakfast first, then go out.

lines.zh: 弟弟四点放学，我六点下班。
lines.py: dì di sì diǎn fàng xué , wǒ liù diǎn xià bān .
lines.en: My younger brother finishes school at four; I finish work at six.

lines.zh: 下班的时候，我常常很累，先回家吃饭。
lines.py: xià bān de shí hou , wǒ cháng cháng hěn lèi , xiān huí jiā chī fàn .
lines.en: I am often tired after work, so I go home and eat first.

lines.zh: 我常在家学习十五分钟，再去上汉语课。
lines.py: wǒ cháng zài jiā xué xí shí wǔ fēn zhōng , zài qù shàng hàn yǔ kè .
lines.en: I often study at home for fifteen minutes, then go to Chinese class.

lines.zh: 这节课九点下课，下课前我们做听写。
lines.py: zhè jié kè jiǔ diǎn xià kè , xià kè qián wǒ men zuò tīng xiě .
lines.en: This class finishes at nine; we do dictation before it finishes.

lines.zh: 下课后，我和朋友认真地读课文，再说五分钟汉语。
lines.py: xià kè hòu , wǒ hé péng you rèn zhēn de dú kè wén , zài shuō wǔ fēn zhōng hàn yǔ .
lines.en: After class, my friend and I read the lesson text carefully, then speak Chinese for five minutes.

lines.zh: 我十一点睡，明天还要早起。
lines.py: wǒ shí yī diǎn shuì , míng tiān hái yào zǎo qǐ .
lines.en: I sleep at eleven; I need to get up early tomorrow too.

lines.zh: 我下班了。白天工作，晚上学习，太累了。
lines.py: wǒ xià bān le . bái tiān gōng zuò , wǎn shang xué xí , tài lèi le .
lines.en: Work is over. Work by day and study by night—it is tiring.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先吃饭，再读。十五分钟，好吗？
lines.py: xiān chī fàn , zài dú . shí wǔ fēn zhōng , hǎo ma ?
lines.en: Eat first, then read. Fifteen minutes, okay?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行。我常在家读书，今天也在家。
lines.py: xíng . wǒ cháng zài jiā dú shū , jīn tiān yě zài jiā .
lines.en: Okay. I often read at home, and I am at home today too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 弟弟放学了吗？
lines.py: dì di fàng xué le ma ?
lines.en: Has your younger brother finished school?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 放学了。他常常上午学习，下午做听写。
lines.py: fàng xué le . tā cháng cháng shàng wǔ xué xí , xià wǔ zuò tīng xiě .
lines.en: Yes. He often studies in the morning and does dictation in the afternoon.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你九点下课，十一点睡。下课后再说五分钟，不用多。
lines.py: nǐ jiǔ diǎn xià kè , shí yī diǎn shuì . xià kè hòu zài shuō wǔ fēn zhōng , bù yòng duō .
lines.en: Class finishes at nine; you sleep at eleven. Another five minutes of speaking after class is enough.
